## 4. Base rates
- The head-to-head favours Denmark. One preview says Denmark are unbeaten in six straight meetings (four wins). Another says Norway have not beaten Denmark since April 1998. The last competitive meeting was a 2-0 Denmark win in Euro qualifying in September 2011. [Sports Mole](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/nations-league/norway-vs-denmark_game_258873.html), [Tapmad](https://www.tapmad.com/blog/norway-vs-denmark-preview-uefa-nations-league-2026-27/8189-5-0)
- For reference, home sides in closely matched European internationals usually win about 45-50% of the time, and about 25% of these games end in draws. This is a general reference figure, not one I verified for this matchup.
- Norway's recent form is strong: they reached the World Cup quarter-finals, and Haaland scored in every group game.
